messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated pool 'eu-dedicated-1' utilization 98% (5m avg) · queue length up 3.2x · autoscaler error: hit max_node_limit · affected: enterprise reservations showing increased latency and throttles :rotating_light:

alice (oncall): I'm on it. paging eng-runtime and eng-platform. opening bridge in 5. ops-bot start-bridge 2211123333 · :telephone_receiver:

diego (eng-runtime): grabbing logs now. initial look: autoscaler threw 'ScaleLimitExceeded' at 2023-09-18T03:04:12Z for group eu-dedicated-1. nodes at 20/20. KV-cache pressure high, constant batch fill -> per-token latency spikes.

sam (eng-platform): Confirmed. autoscaler config for eu-dedicated-1 has max_nodes=20 from last-month reserve change. We didn't roll over emergency-burst policy. We can increase to 30 but need quick approval; will need infra quota bump.

alice (oncall): Approve emergency bump to 30 for next 60m if Diego and Sam think it's safe. Also start mitigation plan: 1) pause best-effort jobs 2) evict non-reserved background tasks 3) enable model-fallback routing for impacted tenants.

mira (support): Heads up — AcmeCorp (enterprise-resv id: R-4432) reporting generation failures and 504s. BetaBank showing backlog in their reserved queue. I'll escalate to account teams and open P1 support tickets.

diego (eng-runtime): Agree on bump. We can also throttle <best-effort> reservation class and drain queued requests into a degraded path where possible (lower model size). Patch incoming:
```
PATCH /internal/autoscaler/config HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{ "pool":"eu-dedicated-1","max_nodes":30, "burst_ttl_mins":60 }
```
I'll apply once Sam flips infra permissions.

sam (eng-platform): Applying quota bump now. ETA ~2m. Also enabling node-pool-add permissions for oncall role for emergencies.

ops-bot: action:quota_bump requested by sam — status: in_progress (req-8871)

alice (oncall): While we wait: Diego, can you list impacted reservation ids and percent queued? Mira, collect customer-facing impact sentences we can send to account reps. Jess, product needs the quick summary for the status page.

diego (eng-runtime): Snapshot: R-4432 (AcmeCorp) queued 270 reqs (100% of their reserved capacity), R-4479 (BetaBank) queued 120 reqs (85%), R-4510 (VelvetPay) queued 50 reqs (70%). Best-effort tenants account for ~40% of active workloads on pool.

mira (support): Draft message for accounts: "We're investigating GPU capacity pressure in eu region affecting reserved capacity. We're increasing emergency capacity and temporarily routing some non-critical requests to degraded paths to restore service. We'll update in 15 minutes or sooner." agree?

jess (product): +1. Add ETA for next update: 15m. Also ask legal for any SLA notes if we plan to evict or re-route reserved workloads.

otsu (acct): I'll DM AcmeCorp and BetaBank with the draft. request to offer temporary hosted fallback endpoints for critical traffic — want to coordinate with support on keys/whitelisting now.

ops-bot: action:quota_bump req-8871 — status: success · nodes increased to 30 · timestamp 2211123450

diego (eng-runtime): Bump applied, autoscaler now sees capacity headroom. Starting controlled scale-up: adding 6 nodes. Monitoring KV-cache warm-up and LRU pressure.

alice (oncall): Good. Next: 1) enact best-effort pause (sam/do it) 2) evict long-running low-priority pods 3) enable routing fallback for R-4432 and R-4479 to smaller model variant (costlier for us short term but reduces latency).

sam (eng-platform): Pausing best-effort queue now: `infractl pool pause --pool eu-dedicated-1 --class best-effort` · paused. Evicting 18 pods flagged low-priority now.

diego (eng-runtime): Routing rule created: `route_set --tenant R-4432 --model small-gpt-j --ttl 30m` and same for R-4479. They will see lower latency but reduced quality. 

mira (support): Sent messages to account teams and offered hosted fallback. AcmeCorp ops replied: "please flip us to fallback now, we can't have 504s". They've authorized keys.

alice (oncall): Apply fallback for AcmeCorp now. Ensure we track any quality/regression alerts for the next hour. Also start incident timeline doc. Who's owning postmortem?

diego (eng-runtime): Fallback applied. Observability: AcmeCorp request latency dropped from 2.3s -> 0.6s and queue drained by 80% in 4m. KV hit-rate warming.

jess (product): Noted. We'll prepare a brief customer-facing banner and coordinate with comms. Please capture exact timestamps and actions in the bridge notes.

otsu (acct): AcmeCorp: acknowledged and on fallback. BetaBank asked for ETA to restore full-reserved performance. I'll relay 30m estimate while we stabilize.

alice (oncall): Closing the immediate page — system stable for now but this is P1. Keep bridge open for 60m and create follow-up ticket to: 1) review autoscaler max_node defaults 2) add emergency-burst policy to pools 3) surfacing reservation saturation metrics to billing/CS.

ops-bot: bridge:2211123333 closed? no — bridge will remain open until 2211123933 · incident-id INC-221112-01

mira (support): Recording action items. I'll coordinate post-incident comms and include affected reservations and timestamps.

diego (eng-runtime): Postmortem owner: Diego. Will include root-cause: config max_nodes too low + noisy-best-effort mix + missing burst policy. Proposed mitigations: default burst allowance, per-tenant QoS enforcement, better autoscaler alerts when queue growth > X%.

alice (oncall): Thanks team. I'll hand off to Diego for postmortem. If any customer escalates before that, tag me. :white_check_mark:
